ṣaṭkarmas
(‘six purificatory exercises [for the body]’)
------------------------------------------
Works on हठयोग lay great stress on cleansing and strengthening the physical body so that it becomes fit enough for the practice of राजयोग. For this, they prescribe the षट्कर्मस् or six purificatory processes.
They are: धौति (washing); बस्ति (cleansing the lower part of the abdomen); नेति (cleaning the nostrils); लौकिकी (movement of stomach-muscles); त्राटक (gazing without winking); कपालभाति (cleansing the inside of cranium).
See under each title for details.
